scope: Complete twelfth numbered juan: Commentary on the Images, Lower Part, hexagrams 31–64. Includes all selected-base material and a labeled supplementary translation of the missing top-line Image of Joy. Not the preface or preliminary juan.
word_count_method: Latin-letter tokens, including hyphenated and apostrophized forms, within source-aligned English blocks; footnote references and image markup excluded. Includes attribution and primary-text labels; excludes added section headings, project front matter, and endnotes.
count_note: The selected base omits Joy’s top-line Small Image, but retains its commentary. Thus 237 base Image passages comprise 34 Great Images and 203 Small Images. The missing Small Image is translated in a labeled endnote, bringing the canonical coverage to 238 without altering base-block alignment.
